dialogue.textjp: はぁーはぁー...どうだ...ッ
あっはは...それで終わり...？
口ほどにもねぇやつらだな...！

dialogue.text: I'm so tired! Let's grill it all already!
dialogue.textjp: もう疲れたぁ！！もう全部焼こうぜ！？

dialogue.text: ... Yeah, I think I'll call it a day.
dialogue.textjp: ...そうだな、今日はこの辺にしといてやるよ

dialogue.text: ... I'll let you off the hook if BF says so.
I'm hungry too. Can I have some meat?
dialogue.textjp: 私もお腹すいちゃった。お肉もらえる？

dialogue.text: After meat, seafood is a good way to refresh your palate... That's not so bad.
dialogue.textjp: 肉の後に魚介でさっぱりもまぁ...悪かねぇか

dialogue.text: when you're tired, you need something sweet.
dialogue.textjp: 疲れた時には甘い物ってな

dialogue.text: Ha ha ha! You guys aren't so honest!
dialogue.textjp: あっはは！素直じゃねぇなお前ら！

dialogue.text: These are all delicious after all!
dialogue.textjp: やっぱ全部美味しいんじゃん！
